verdict.rationale: Warp is itself an agentic coding assistant/agent product; the evidence (warp-docs-18, warp-docs-52) shows Warp connecting to external MCP servers (client-side) rather than exposing its own agent as an official MCP server that other agents can plug into. Per the agent-role exception, this axis does not apply unless there's explicit evidence of an MCP-serve mode, which is absent (the vague 'API, CLI, SDK and MCP' platform tagline in warp-docs-42 is not concrete server evidence).
